newsitem.title: USA: Nebraska fed cattle light at $109/dressed - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Nebraska fed cattle light at $109/dressed - USDA.

text.p: Steers and heifers were lightly tested, with a few sales steady to $1.00 per cwt higher on a dressed basis delivered (paid on hot carcass weights), according to USDA.
Dressed Basis Steers - Few Select and Choice 2-3 1200-1300 lbs 107.50- 109.00 (weighted average 108.17).
Dressed Basis Heifers - Few Select and Choice 2-3 1100-1200 lbs 107.50- 109.00 (weighted average 108.16).
Slaughter steers and heifers were not well tested on a live basis. Demand uneven, but fairly good to several packers. Seller interest limited.
Live basis sales - Equivalent 3 percent shrink delivered and FOB, some FOB 4% shrink.
Slaughter Steers - Few Select and Choice 2-3 1200-1225 lbs 65.50. Slaughter Heifers - No confirmed sales.
Confirmed - 1,800 Last Week - 1,500 Last Year - 400 Wk To Date - None. Sm Pd Lst Wk- None. Sm Pd Lst Yr - None.
